about: Neulactil (periciazine, a conventional antipsychotic on the list) is supplied every month for nine months and appears by brand name only.
Serenace (haloperidol) 5 mg twice a day, which is 10 mg a day and 5 mg in a single dose, is supplied four times from January 2026 to March 2026, in the middle of a 15-month history.
Serenace (haloperidol) 1.5 mg twice a day is only 3 mg a day and 1.5 mg in a single dose, which is under both limits on the list. No other antipsychotic is supplied.
